description: PROTECT-90: A Fault Dataset for Power System Protection 90 kV Double-Line EMT Fault Waveform Dataset for High-Voltage Protection Open, Standardized Voltage and Current Waveforms for Reproducible Protection and Transient is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Georg Kordowich, Julian Oelhaf (Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg). PROTECT-90 is an open high-voltage fault waveform dataset for reproducible research in power system protection, transient waveform analysis, and learning-based fault analysis. The dataset contains 9,022 electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation episodes generated on a standardized 90 kV double-line transmission topology. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
